review.item_premise: This isolated reader accepts public untrusted annotation bytes and explicit finite budgets. The canonical interchange walker validates syntax and reserves under the caller ceiling before map-shape checks; the host visitor reads only names and byte-string framing. No private input, producer state, version selector, core verification or I/O enters these bodies. Public input and structural result are recorded at the three public boundaries; no content is promoted to admission authority.
